newsitem.title: USA: Corrections Corp D.C. inmate plan set aside.
newsitem.headline: Corrections Corp D.C. inmate plan set aside.

text.p: Corrections Corp of America said Thursday today that its pending contract to house 1,500 inmates for the District of Columbia in a facility it has built in Youngstown, Ohio is being set aside in lieu of an expedited formal solicitation process.
Corrections Corp said that it does not expect this delay to have a material adverse effect on its operating results in the first half of 1997.
"Because the District is under considerable budgetary pressure, we anticipate the process will be accelerated," said Doctor Crants, chairman and chief executive officer in a press release.
The company said it believes that its Youngstown facility has the only available 1,500-bed, medium-security, all-cell space in the country.
It said it has alternative customers for this facility but will participate in the District's procurement process.
